pairs: Cernens autem Rachel quod infecunda esset,
Then Rachel, discerning that she was infertile,
invidit sorori suæ, et ait marito suo:
envied her sister, and so she said to her husband,
Jacob, being angry, responded to her,
“Am I in the place of God,
qui privavit te fructu ventris tui?
who has deprived you of the fruit of your womb?”
ingredere ad illam, ut pariat super genua mea,
Go in to her, so that she may give birth upon my knees,
and I may have sons by her.”
Deditque illi Balam in conjugium: quæ,
And she gave him Bilhah in marriage.
And when her husband had gone in to her,
and he has heeded my voice,
et idcirco appellavit nomen ejus Dan.
And because of this, she called his name Dan.
Comparavit me Deus cum sorore mea,
“God has compared me with my sister,
Leah, perceiving that she had desisted from child-bearing,
delivered Zilpah, her handmaid, to her husband.
And she, after having borne a son with difficulty,
et idcirco vocavit nomen ejus Gad.
And for this reason, she called his name Gad.
Indeed, women will call me blessed.”
Because of this, she called him Asher.
Egressus autem Ruben tempore messis triticeæ in agrum,
Then Reuben, going out into the field at the time of the wheat harvest,
reperit mandragoras, quas matri Liæ detulit.
found mandrakes. These he brought to his mother Leah.
Da mihi partem de mandragoris filii tui.
“Give me a portion of your son’s mandrakes.”
Parumne tibi videtur quod præripueris maritum mihi,
“Does it seem like such a small matter to you, that you have usurped from me my husband,
nisi etiam mandragoras filii mei tuleris?
unless you will also take my son’s mandrakes?”
Dormiat tecum hac nocte pro mandragoris filii tui.
“He will sleep with you this night because of your son’s mandrakes.”
Redeuntique ad vesperam Jacob de agro, egressa est in occursum ejus Lia,
And when Jacob returned from the field in the evening, Leah went out to meet him,
quia mercede conduxi te pro mandragoris filii mei.
because I have hired you for the reward of my son’s mandrakes.”
And he slept with her that night.
And she conceived and bore a fifth son.
“God has given a reward to me,
quia dedi ancillam meam viro meo:
because I gave my handmaid to my husband.”
And she called his name Issachar.
“God has endowed me with a good dowry.
etiam hac vice mecum erit maritus meus,
And now, at this turn, my husband will be with me,
eo quod genuerim ei sex filios:
because I have conceived six sons for him.”
et idcirco appellavit nomen ejus Zabulon.
And therefore she called his name Zebulun.
After him, she bore a daughter,
heeded her and opened her womb.
And she called his name Joseph,
“The Lord has added to me another son.”
Dimitte me ut revertar in patriam,
so that I may return to my native country and to my land.
for whom I have served you,
tu nosti servitutem qua servivi tibi.
You know the servitude with which I have served you.”
“May I find grace in your sight.
experimento didici, quia benedixerit mihi Deus propter te:
I have learned by experience that God has blessed me because of you.
constitue mercedem tuam quam dem tibi.
Choose your wages, which I will give you.”
“You know how I have served you,
et quanta in manibus meis fuerit possessio tua.
and how great your possession became in my hands.
Modicum habuisti antequam venirem ad te,
You had little before I came to you,
and now you have achieved riches.
benedixitque tibi Dominus ad introitum meum.
And the Lord has blessed you since my arrival. It is just,
Justum est igitur ut aliquando provideam etiam domui meæ.
therefore, that at some time I also should provide for my own house.”
But if you will do what I ask,
Go around through all your flocks
and separate all the sheep of variegated
tam in ovibus quam in capris,
as much among the sheep as among the goats,
And my justice will answer on my behalf tomorrow,
quando placiti tempus advenerit coram te:
when the time of settlement arrives before you.
et omnia quæ non fuerint varia,
And all that is not variegated
tam in ovibus quam in capris,
as much among the sheep as among the goats,
these will prove me to be a thief.”
Et separavit in die illa capras,
And on that day he separated the she-goats,
and the rams with variegations or with blemishes.
But every one of the flock which was of one color,
id est albi et nigri velleris,
of white or of black fleece,
he delivered into the hands of his sons.
Et posuit spatium itineris trium dierum inter se et generum,
And he established a distance of three days journey between himself and his son-in-law,
who pastured the remainder of his flock.
Tollens ergo Jacob virgas populeas virides,
Then Jacob, taking green branches of poplar,
ex parte decorticavit eas: detractisque corticibus,
debarked them in part. And when the bark was pulled off,
in the parts that were stripped,
yet the parts that were left whole,
atque in hunc modum color effectus est varius.
in this way the color was made variegated.
And he placed them in the troughs,
where the water was poured out,
ut cum venissent greges ad bibendum,
so that when the flocks had arrived to drink,
they would have the branches before their eyes,
and in their sight they might conceive.
Factumque est ut in ipso calore coitus,
in the very heat of joining together,
the sheep looked upon the branches,
and they bore the blemished and the variegated,
et posuit virgas in canalibus ante oculos arietum:
and he set the branches in the troughs before the eyes of the rams.
erant autem alba et nigra quæque,
Now whatever was white or black belonged to Laban,
for the flocks were dispersed among one another.
Igitur quando primo tempore ascendebantur oves,
ponebat Jacob virgas in canalibus aquarum ante oculos arietum
when the first to arrive were climbing on the ewes,
Jacob placed the branches in the troughs of water before the eyes of the rams and the sheep,
so that they might conceive while they were gazing upon them.
quando vero serotina admissura erat, et conceptus extremus,
Yet when the late arrivals and the last to conceive were let in,
Factaque sunt ea quæ erant serotina,
And so those that arrived late became Laban’s,
Laban: et quæ primi temporis, Jacob.
and those that arrived first became Jacob’s.
And the man was enriched beyond limit,
